d:
Soniye O Meri Soniye is one of those timeless melodies that captures love, rhythm, and pure Punjabi soul.
Sung by Daler Mehndi, this track carries the vibrant energy and infectious charm that made the Bolo Ta Ra Ra era unforgettable. From its catchy hook to its unmistakable Punjabi flavour, Soniye O Meri Soniye continues to resonate with fans across generations.
Whether you’re rediscovering this classic or hearing it for the first time, turn up the volume and let the nostalgia flow.
Listen, feel the rhythm, and celebrate the music that never ages.
Soniye O Meri Soniye - Daler Mehndi
